name: Taniwha
description: Supernatural beings in Māori tradition that inhabit deep pools, rivers, harbours, caves, and dangerous coastal waters of Aotearoa (New Zealand), acting as both guardians (kaitiaki) and monstrous threats.

aliases.name: *tanifa
aliases.meaning: reconstructed ancestor of the word, referring to a dangerous shark species

aliases.name: Tanifa / Tanifoa
aliases.meaning: cognate terms for large or dangerous sharks

origin: Taniwha are particular to Aotearoa (New Zealand), with cognate water beings throughout Polynesia.
